comments.author: Jiblet
comments.body_html:
SVM can handle the resizing, and has a GUI for those that can’t handle sticking numbers in to a config JSON file.

The difference comes in how each handles item filters in the containers. SVM can turn simply them on and off, whereas this mod can change them, so you can add allowable items to particular cases as you see fit. It just takes a littl tiny bit of work to look up items in the Tarkov db site,

https://items.sp-tarkov.com/

comments.author: Jiblet
comments.body_html:
Add it?

See this section:

Extensibility

You can use this mod out of the box to make the changes described below, but if you have the urge to make changes to other cases that I’ve not thought of, or you want to change my changes, well now you can! And with no need for coding experience. Everything is handled within the config.json file, and I believe in you!

The Readme contains pretty detailed instructions. as well as warnings, so please read those and be careful.
